svg.text: Shared L2, textbook form: 12 MiB, 12 ways, 128 B lines in two halves, physically indexed and hashed
Four cores share it. The index is physical and partly hashed, each line is two independent 64 B halves, and the replacement spares lines an L1 still holds.
